mode_detail: hidden-browser run-ahead and timer test on; Nightshift model calls allowed; price history from the fixture; Trust Agent real
notes: confirmed = Deal Agent confirmed it with evidence; the Skeptic checked evidence (its rechecker covers best_price only, with AGENT_PRICE=real)
trick detection = planted pages (expected=1) only; honest controls (expected=0) are scored in false alarms; every other page is listed as excluded with its reason
false alarm = a confirmed fake_discount, resetting_timer, drip_fees or prechecked_addon finding on a clean page (expected=0 or clean_control); trust/no_https and not_connected findings do not count
shopper-visible false alarm = a clean page whose card shows >= 1 trick (card.tricks), whatever the finding's status; listed next to the confirmed-only line because the two can differ

scam detection = risky stores (expected=1) whose card.safe is caution or bad (unsafe); trust false alarms = legitimate stores (expected=0) flagged the same way; Trust findings are never 'confirmed', so the card decides
exact match = look-alike listings (lookalike_listing labels) the Price Agent rejects; no page is labelled yet, so it is n/a, never a made-up rate

card fields: trick detection and confirmed false alarms read the findings, not the card; shopper-visible false alarms read card.tricks (what the card shows the shopper); scam detection reads card.safe. Per-page columns: Tone/tricks = card.tone/card.tricks, Safe = card.safe. The card headline (title, tone) is not scored
timer pages take longer in full mode: the timer test makes 3 fresh visits TIMER_GAP_S seconds apart; the median is page load (page.goto) to the last final card, one page at a time
